title: Inside Marseille’s Devastating Plague of 1720
description:
In 1720, Marseille faced a devastating plague epidemic. Follow the Grand Saint-Antoine’s return, the quarantine decisions at the port, the spread of plague through the city, and the final fate of the ship and its captain.
